start: AI Assistant open on the Ask tab, owner signed in online, 6 questions left today

steps.action: Type a question in the box "Ask or give a task, in Hindi or English" and press the round send button
user_sees: "Thinking…"
An answer card
Above the box: "5 free questions left today."
must_not: The line shows while more than 5 are left
The number goes up after a question
A credit is taken for the question

steps.action: Ask four more questions, one after the other
user_sees: The number falls by one each time
At one left: "1 free question left today."
must_not: "1 free questions left today."
The line stays on an old number

steps.action: Ask one more, then another after it
user_sees: A calm line (not red): "You have used today's {n} free questions. Your credits are safe. Ask again tomorrow."
The box is greyed out with "No more free questions today. Ask again tomorrow."
The microphone and send buttons are off
must_not: A red error
The credit balance changes
The box still takes typing
The line above the box still says a number left

start: A message card is open in the chat; the last question of the day was just used

steps.action: On the message card tap "Shorter" (a rewrite also counts as a question)
user_sees: The card says today's questions are used up, in the same calm words
The ask box locks at once
must_not: The card says only "Try again"
The Send button of the card stays stuck on busy
The typed message words are lost

steps.action: On a workout plan card tap "Write the plan"
user_sees: The same calm line on the card
The card goes back to how it was
must_not: A plan is written
Credits are taken
The card shows "Writing…" for ever

start: The ask box is locked: today's questions are used up

steps.action: Tap a row under "Today for you", or a button on an older answer card such as "Send them a fee reminder"
user_sees: A plain word that no more questions can be asked today
must_not: A new question goes out
The tap does nothing at all with no word why
A credit is taken

steps.action: Tap "See who" on an idea (worked out on the device, no AI)
user_sees: The member list card
must_not: The list is refused because of the day limit

steps.action: Tap Send on a message card drafted earlier today
user_sees: The message is sent and 1 credit is used
must_not: Sending a ready task is blocked by the question limit

start: The ask box is locked: today's questions are used up

steps.action: Reload the page and open the AI Assistant again
user_sees: The box is locked, or it opens and the next question brings the same calm line and locks it again
must_not: A question is answered after the limit
A red "You have asked a lot today"

steps.action: Open the AI Assistant the next day (after midnight in India)
user_sees: The box is open, no "left today" line
must_not: Yesterday's lock or yesterday's number still shows

user_sees: An answer, and the count starts again
must_not: The first answer of the day says 0 left

start: A gym with an owner and a front-desk login; the owner has used today's questions

steps.action: Sign in as front desk and look for the AI Assistant
user_sees: No floating button, no menu entry, no count
must_not: Staff see how many questions the owner asked
Staff can use up the owner's questions

steps.action: Sign in as the owner on a second device
user_sees: The limit holds there too once a question is tried
must_not: A second device gives a fresh allowance
The line says the credits were used
